name: Student Carolers on Miracle Mile and Giralda Plaza
host: City of Coral Gables Economic Development Department
venue: Miracle Mile and Giralda Plaza, Downtown Coral Gables
address: Downtown Coral Gables, Coral Gables, FL 33134
when_note: Five evenings, 7 to 9 PM: December 4, 11, 12, 18 and 19
paras: Local high school choirs bring holiday music to Miracle Mile and Giralda Plaza in downtown Coral Gables on five evenings in December. From 7 to 9 PM, student carolers in festive attire stroll through downtown singing holiday favorites while residents and visitors shop, dine and explore.

The city lists a different choir each night: Miami Senior High School on Friday, December 4; Florida Christian School on Friday, December 11; Hialeah Gardens Senior High School on Saturday, December 12; Doral Academy Preparatory and Miami Senior High School on Friday, December 18; and New World School of the Arts and Hialeah Senior High School on Saturday, December 19.
The Coral Gables Economic Development Department sponsors the annual program. The city's page marks the dates as subject to change, so check the city calendar before heading downtown.
tip: Come on December 4 and pair the carolers with the city tree lighting at Merrick Park that same evening.
